text:
Ivy: Flagging a UX inconsistency in the metrics panel legend + sparklines. Units are shown on the y-axis but the legend items don't show units, which confuses folks when multiple metrics are side-by-side.
Luis: Saw this in the customer demo. They asked: is the legend value in % or absolute? There's no suffix.
Priya: Can we append a short unit badge next to the legend label? e.g., "Errors \u2022  requests/s" or a small muted chip 'req/s'. Keeps legend compact but explicit.
Ivy: Preference for chip over inline text — better scannability. But need to watch visual weight.
DesignAssistant: Accessibility reminder: any unit chip must have visible text (not just color) and be readable at 14px. Also needs aria-label like "Errors, requests per second".
Marta: Implementation constraint: current legend is horizontally scrollable on narrow widths. Chips could push overflow. Maybe allow truncation with tooltip: "Errors (req/s)" on hover.
Sam: Alternative: show units in a condensed secondary row under the label for stacked legends. Mobile shows the chip only on tap.
Luis: Another nit: smoothing toggle placement. Right now it's in the legend toolbar which is easy to miss. Suggest move to a per-widget overflow menu with a visible 'Curve' affordance when hovered.
Priya: Smoothing vs sampling again — call the control 'Curve (visual only)' and keep 'Resolution' as the sampling dropdown in the data settings.
Ivy: UX flow: hover legend -> show 'More' menu -> controls: Curve (on/off), Resolution (opens subpanel), Outlier handling (clip/scale/log). Keeps legend compact.
DesignAssistant: Outlier handling options must be explained inline: 'Clip: cap extreme values; Scale: compress with log; Show: raw'. Add small helper text for clarity.
Marta: Accessibility: ensure the overflow menu is keyboard reachable and that each menu action has a clear focus style. Also ensure screen readers get the current state (e.g., "Curve on").
Sam: Copy idea for the helper: "Outlier handling affects visual rendering only and does not change underlying stored values. Use 'Clip' to limit extreme spikes for readability."
Luis: For legend contrast: muted chip used currently blends into background on dark theme. Increase contrast ratio to meet AA.
Priya: UX decision? Show unit chip + move smoothing to overflow + add helper copy + a11y fixes for keyboard/aria. If yes I'll update the component spec.
Ivy: Sounds good. Action items: @Marta -> accessibility checklist & a11y ticket, @Sam -> propose mobile behavior, @Luis -> update CSS tokens for contrast, @Priya -> update component spec + copy.
DesignAssistant: Created tasks: DESIGN-1188 (legend unit chip + overflow menu), A11Y-245 (legend menu keyboard/aria), ENG-5299 (legend overflow behavior + contrast tokens).
Ivy: Quick mock request: Priya, can you show both chip and secondary-row options so we can validate truncation behavior?
Priya: Will do. Mock ready by EOD tomorrow.
Luis: Quick code hint for a11y live announcement when toggling Curve: 
```
const announce = (msg) => { liveRegion.textContent = msg }
announce('Curve enabled for Errors')
```
Ivy: Thanks — love the concrete sample. We'll review the mocks in tomorrow design sync.
